Melania Trump receives Ukraine’s Order of Princess Olha at White House meeting on Oleshky evacuation — Meduza

U.S. first lady Melania Trump met with Russian and Ukrainian representatives at the White House following a humanitarian mission in the occupied town of Oleshky. Russia was represented by ombudswoman Yana Lantratova and presidential special envoy Kirill Dmitriev; Ukraine was represented by ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets and Davyd Arakhamia, who heads the Servant of the People faction in parliament.

Actual Article Body:
U.S. first lady Melania Trump met with Russian and Ukrainian representatives at the White House following a humanitarian mission in the occupied town of Oleshky. Russia was represented by ombudswoman Yana Lantratova and presidential special envoy Kirill Dmitriev; Ukraine was represented by ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets and Davyd Arakhamia, who heads the Servant of the People faction in parliament.

The first lady said she had been involved in every stage of preparations for the humanitarian mission. “I reviewed demining plans, aerial images, assessed roadways, and discussed evacuation routes, hospital access, vehicles, and medical resources. I was made aware of the preferred dates and timing of the operation,” Melania Trump said.

She also said about 800 people had been evacuated from Oleshky. Neither Russia nor Ukraine has confirmed that figure. Shortly after the humanitarian mission ended, Lantratova said 750 residents had been given the opportunity to leave the city for Ukraine or Russia, but “far fewer than 750 people left.” Lubinets said the two sides had agreed not to disclose how many Oleshky residents had left for Ukraine and how many for Russia.

Melania Trump said the ceasefire in Oleshky would have been impossible without the involvement of the presidents of Russia and Ukraine. In her view, their cooperation on this issue sets “a meaningful precedent for advancing peace throughout the region.” She gave Arakhamia and Dmitriev personal letters for Volodymyr Zelensky and Vladimir Putin.

Dmitriev spoke after the first lady. He thanked her for saving “many lives.” He gave her a drawing that he said was by Lidia, an 11-year-old girl evacuated from Oleshky. The drawing reads: “I love Melania.”

Ukraine’s representatives, Arakhamia and Lubinets, spoke after Dmitriev. Arakhamia said the Oleshky ceasefire was the most significant de-escalation since 2022. “We are creating a momentum where both sides are learning the… mechanics of how to actually keep the peace when the peace comes,” he said. Lubinets presented the first lady with the Order of Princess Olga, First Class. Zelensky had signed the decree awarding it to Melania Trump on November 2.

Lantratova did not speak at the meeting. The reason is unknown.

U.S. President Donald Trump met with Dmitriev at the White House, then announced a “big beautiful agreement” on Ukraine that “might involve all of Europe.” He said he had held a separate meeting only with Russia’s representative, not with Ukraine’s...
